figurative_meaning_en: To be revealed or highlighted; to gain beauty or prominence
example_sentences_in_bangla: নতুন শাড়ীতে রংটা খুব সুন্দর খুলেছে।
এই আলোয় ছবির রং খুলে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The color of the new sari has really come out beautifully.
In this light, the painting's colors are blooming vibrantly.
note: Commonly used in contexts describing how colors enhance appearance, especially in traditional attire.
